reasoning_content: The tex2pdf expects CHANGELOG.md at build context root. It's a monorepo-root file that got lost in the export. Let me copy it into the build context.

action.command:
cp /workspace/CHANGELOG.md /tmp/g_tex2pdf-service/CHANGELOG.md
cd /tmp/g_tex2pdf-service && export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 timeout 590 docker build --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN -t tex2pdf-service . > /tmp/build_tex2pdf3.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -8 /tmp/build_tex2pdf3.log

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cp /workspace/CHANGELOG.md /tmp/g_tex2pdf-service/CHANGELOG.md\ncd /tmp/g_tex2pdf-service && export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 timeout 590 docker build --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN -t tex2pdf-service . > /tmp/build_tex2pdf3.log 2>&1; echo \"rc=$?\"; tail -8 /tmp/build_tex2pdf3.log", "summary": "Rebuild tex2pdf with CHANGELOG"}
